spec: SPEC.md §7.4, REQ-376: a regression in any layer-3 metric larger than its pre-registered tolerance blocks the release unless the changelog explains it

units.kappa: Cohen's kappa, a decrease larger than this blocks
units.latency: ms, an increase of the median (absolute) latency difference larger than this blocks
units.recall: fraction (3 percentage points), a decrease larger than this blocks
